add: Accept ADR-0058 and build a reviewed restore path for one owner: an admin route or runbook that uses the Durable Object bookmark API, run as a staging drill. It must handle three side effects. Grants and schedules must be re-checked before anything runs.

gap: Waldo keeps every chat message, quoted email and memory row for as long as the account exists. Health data has a scheduled sweep and short-lived intake queues expire, but no retention schedule by data class is decided or enforced for the durable record.
